_comment: Crypto-backend-purity gate policy (DATA, not code). ADR-0506 mandates aws-lc-rs as the SINGLE crypto backend and forbids ring. ADR-0506 DESCRIBES the zero-ring invariant ('buck2 cquery deps(//...) | grep ring-0.17 == 0') but nothing MECHANICALLY enforced it; this gate is that enforcement. The asserted signal is local Buck graph ACTIVATION, NOT the Cargo.lock / cargo-metadata dependency SUPERSET. CRITICAL: Cargo.lock can retain a `ring 0.17` stanza as an UNACTIVATED optional-dep phantom; asserting on the lock/metadata superset would FALSE-RED on a harmless phantom. The collector reads first-party BUCK roots plus generated third-party/BUCK edges and never invokes Cargo, so it fails only when a forbidden backend is reachable from the build graph. ALL repo-specifics are DATA here: a different repo adopts the gate by repointing forbidden/mandated; the Rust engine hardcodes no crate name. The true Cargo.lock-phantom purge is separate migration work; the lock phantom is harmless because it is never built — this gate enforces the invariant that actually matters (zero forbidden-backend ACTIVATION).

forbidden.reason: ADR-0506 forbids ring as a crypto backend; aws-lc-rs is the single canonical Phase-1 backend. ring must never be ACTIVATED (compiled) in the local Buck graph.

mandated.reason: ADR-0506 canonical Phase-1 crypto backend (oya-crypto is the Tier-4 bespoke destination).

product_contract.activation_not_superset: The gate asserts on the local Buck ACTIVATED graph, distinguishing an ACTIVATED forbidden backend (FAIL) from the documented Cargo.lock/cargo-metadata unactivated optional-dep phantom (OK). It MUST NOT assert on Cargo.lock text nor on cargo-metadata resolve.nodes[].dependencies/deps[] (the unfiltered superset that contains the phantom).
product_contract.born_blocking: The workspace is ring-free in activation today (PR #725 / ADR-0506 G002 zero-ring), so the expected finding set is empty and the gate is RED-blocking on arrival: any NEW first-party Buck root that reaches a forbidden backend fails closed immediately.
product_contract.pack_shaped: forbidden, mandated, and min_expected_workspace_packages are DATA; the Rust engine hardcodes no crate name. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing this policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: An unreadable or unparseable local Buck graph, a policy gate_id mismatch, or a too-small package census all fail CLOSED rather than silently passing as a false-green.

purpose: Crypto-backend-purity gate. Mechanically ENFORCES the ADR-0506 zero-ring invariant: ring (and any other forbidden crypto backend) is never ACTIVATED/compiled in the local Buck dependency graph; aws-lc-rs is the mandated single backend.
